title: Annual Information Return of Creditable Income Taxes Withheld (Expanded)/Income Payments Exempt from Withholding Tax
worst_finding: Page 1 Item 7 Registered Address truncates our 126-character address at '...1258 PASEO DE' (dropping the last 55 characters: 'ROXAS COR AYALA AVE BRGY SAN LORENZO MAKATI CITY') instead of overflowing with the shared white band.

test_return.schedules: All 4 quarterly rows of Schedule 1 (1601-EQ) and all 12 monthly rows of Schedule 2 (1606) filled with large amounts; Page 2 Part III Schedules 3 & 4 are format-only on the official BIR form (no writer keys). Saved and reloaded from Filings.

findings.detail: The 126-character address is split across the 40-slot line 1 and 31-slot line 2 combs and hard-truncated at 'UNIT 1408 TOWER B RESIDENCIAS DE SAN LOR / ENZO CONDOMINIUM 1258 PASEO DE', dropping the remaining 55 characters ('ROXAS COR AYALA AVE BRGY SAN LORENZO MAKATI CITY'). By contrast, 1604C prints the full address across both lines.
Official PDF has a 4-slot comb with pre-printed '2 0' and two empty year slots. Frozen sheet uses a plain text cell and prints '2025' left-aligned with no comb ticks.
Official 'Guidelines and Instructions for BIR Form No. 1604-E' block is omitted from the frozen sheet, leaving the bottom half of Page 2 blank.

verified_ok: Part II Schedule 1 (Q1-Q4 + TOTAL: 192,995,672.50) and Schedule 2 (Jan-Dec + TOTAL: 299,652,075.96) all print cleanly with right-aligned Taxes Withheld, Penalties, and Total Amount Remitted.

Page 1 Item 4 TIN, Item 5 RDO (039), Item 6 Name (full 40-char name), Item 7A ZIP (1100), Items 8/8A, Item 9 Contact Number, Item 10 Email, and Page 2 header TIN and Withholding Agent's Name all print cleanly without truncation.
